messages:
Anya: Quick sync — catalog dry run tomorrow at 10am PT. Need short statuses for new open models (oryx-7b, zephyr-3b, talon-2.1): perf profiles, license clearance, and canary owners. Anyone blocked?

Sam: Oryx-7b perf: done. FP16 + q4_0 tests stable on rtx-gpu pools. p50 token latency 18ms, throughput ~120 tok/s under batch=8. Uploading perf artifact: https://redwood.ci/artifacts/oryx-7b/2912

Harpreet: Zephyr-3b licensing flagged — non-commercial clause found. Legal is looped (cc @morgan). Waiting on confirmation if we can redistribute quantized weights. license-bot reported details below.

license-bot: ⚠️ license-check: zephyr-3b -> usage restriction: non-commercial. Action: legal_review required. URL: https://licensing.redwood/zephyr-3b

Morgan: I'm on legal. If redistribution is blocked we can still serve via hosted-only variant. Need owner decision on canary scope by EOD. @sam can you confirm model variant parity?

Sam: I can run parity tests tonight. If weights can't be redistributed we'll serve a wrapper that proxies to hosted weights (will need routing policy). Quick command to run local perf smoke:
```
./perf_runner --model oryx-7b --batch 8 --seq 512 --target p50
```

Dima: CR ping for the catalog metadata PR (#4823). I left comments about schema fields for license_url and perm_flags. @anya can you assign reviewer?

Anya: Assigned to @morgan and @harpreet. Also please ensure 'owner' field is filled (person email preferred). We'll freeze canary config at 09:30 tomorrow.

Morgan: Got it. I'll approve CR after a small doc tweak. :thumbsup:

Harpreet: Blocking item: legal confirmation for zephyr-3b. Otherwise rollout ready. Also asking infra for an extra rtx-node for canary, @eng-infra FYI.

Sam: noted, will queue the parity job. :eyes:

Anya: Thanks everyone — short followups in the morning. If legal clears earlier ping in this thread.
